title: Apple-pectin missing requirement overstates the evidence needed for a bounded source material
description: Case82 already has explicit apple-derived pectin as one alternative carbon material in TOGO M2313. Supplier, esterification and grade remain unknown, but those facts are not necessary to preserve the apple-specific heterogeneous-material boundary. Current missing_requirement couples the representability decision to obtaining the actual supplier/grade. This is a narrow evidence-versus-curation distinction, not an exact pectin mapping approval.

current_decision.reasoning: The source specifies apple-derived pectin as an alternate carbon material. CHEBI:17309 is a pectin class, not a guarantee of identical esterification, molecular-weight distribution or botanical preparation. An apple-source restriction is meaningful for a heterogeneous polysaccharide material; a broad parent relation can support it, but generic pectin exact identity would erase that restriction.
current_decision.applicability: Applies to the sole minimal-media occurrence and its explicit apple qualifier; no supplier or grade is specified in the frozen recipe.
current_decision.no_change_reason: A separate source-qualified apple-pectin identity needs a primary procurement/material specification; genericPectin is only a parent candidate.
current_decision.missing_requirement: Identify the recipe's actual apple-pectin supplier/grade and whether source-specific material identity can be represented with a stable registry identifier and broad pectin mapping.
current_decision.native_review_scope: Source case review and candidate-owner inspection only. No full native owner review or scientific approval is claimed.

bounded_fix: Separate unknown supplier/grade/esterification from the already established apple-material identity. Assess a duplicate-safe source-qualified material or occurrence route, or explain a precise remaining boundary obstacle. Keep source alternatives and unknown fine identity explicit; do not exact-map to generic pectin.
acceptance_conditions: The decision acknowledges the supported apple-material boundary and identifies bounded curation separately from missing supplier/grade.
Preserve the0.2% alternative-source context; do not turn the alternative list into simultaneous recipe components or infer product composition/roles.
Any later payload receives full independent review and coordinator selection; no forced new owner or exact class mapping.
deduplication_context: Related completion theme to original007, which concerned four different cases and is now resolved within that original scope. Coordinator owns deduplication/file-first triage.

title: Three supported source boundaries allow bounded follow-up without clearing finer identity holds
description: Cases28PPG2000,80DI WATER and112A5 already contain useful nominal material/preparation facts. Their exact product/structure, water preparation routing, or normalized copper-formulation questions remain distinct. The A5 decision correctly blocks a complete normalized payload/exact merge until its literal CuSO2·5H2O conflict is resolved; it does not falsely deny every possible partial transcription. These are follow-up opportunities, not new unsafe-mapping defects or mandatory identity releases.

current_decision.reasoning: NBRC1400 names polypropylene glycol2000 and prepares an emulsion by sonication. The2000 denotes a nominal polymer-molecular-weight grade, not one molecule; it does not identify chain-length distribution or end-group/product specification. Polyethylene glycol2000 is chemically different.
current_decision.applicability: The sole NBRC1400 occurrence uses2g/LPPG2000. The source determines polymer family and nominal grade while leaving commercial specification unreported. Exact frozen scopes: CultureMech:008679:ingredients/6
current_decision.no_change_reason: No fixed molecular formula, monomer ontology identity or PEG2000 alias is justified.
current_decision.missing_requirement: Obtain a manufacturer/catalog or polymer specification tied to NBRC1400 that defines end groups and nominal molecular-weight grade; select a polymer-grade registry identity rather than a monomer/PEG mapping.

current_decision.reasoning: ATCC2686 gives DI WATER1 L. DI indicates deionized water, while the current Distilled_Water owner specifically represents distillation and already rejects several other preparation labels. The common H2O molecular identityCHEBI:15377 does not prove preparation equivalence, and the frozen1 G_PER_L is an import unit error.
current_decision.applicability: The sole Nautilia profundicola medium occurrence is solvent water prepared by deionization; its1 L quantity is not1 g/L solute.
current_decision.no_change_reason: Do not addDI WATER as an exact synonym of the distilled-water preparation.
current_decision.missing_requirement: Represent deionized-water preparation separately or use a verified preparation-neutral water owner with deionization retained at the occurrence; do not collapse the distinct water-preparation records.
current_decision.native_review_scope: Source case review and candidate-owner inspection only. No full native owner review or scientific approval is claimed.

current_decision.reasoning: The A5 trace-metal mix is a source-defined multimetal stock. TOGO2499 supplies the full list, but its copper line reads CuSO2·5H2O, which cannot safely be silently normalized to common copper sulfate pentahydrate. Existing generic A5 naming alone does not resolve that formula conflict.
current_decision.applicability: The single BG11 occurrence adds1ml stock, whereas the flattened frozen unit isG_PER_L. The captured exact A5 formulation is the relevant scope.
current_decision.no_change_reason: Resolve the copper formula against the original BG11/A5 specification before a complete component payload or exact-owner merge; retain the ml addition and all source qualifiers.
current_decision.missing_requirement: Resolve the copper formula against the original BG11/A5 specification before a complete component payload or exact-owner merge; retain the ml addition and all source qualifiers.

Run duplicate review and preserve all genuine unknowns; no correction is applied by this review.
